name: Proper Unlabeled Compression for Tope Classes
statement: Every oriented-matroid or affine-oriented-matroid tope class of VC dimension $d$ has a proper unlabeled compression scheme of size at most $d$. The same holds for every COM tope graph with a corner peeling, and hence for realizable COMs, rank-at-most-two COMs, hypercellular graphs, and cellular graphs.
